issues.description: Method Farm.addAnimal(Animal): The UML in problem_statement.md declares addAnimal(animal: Animal) with return type boolean, while the solution implementation defines public void addAnimal(Animal animal). The template's Main invocation of farm.addAnimal(...) does not expect a return value. This inconsistency between the problem statement UML and the provided code can confuse students about the correct return type to implement and may lead to signature mismatches against the provided template/solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and code consistent. Two options: (A) Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare addAnimal(animal: Animal): void so it matches the template and solution and the example usage in Main. (B) Or change the Farm.addAnimal implementation in the template and solution to return boolean (for example: public boolean addAnimal(Animal animal) { return animals.add(animal); }) and update any calling code or tests to handle the boolean return. Option A is recommended to preserve the existing template/solution behavior and example usage.
